stem: Aluminium oxide, $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, and phosphorus(V) oxide, $\text{P}_4\text{O}_{10}$, are both used as reagents and catalysts.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The melting point of $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ is $2072^{\circ}\text{C}$. The melting point of $\text{P}_4\text{O}_{10}$ is $340^{\circ}\text{C}$.

Explain the difference in the melting points of these two compounds.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
A $5.00\text{dm}^3$ sealed flask contains $0.400\text{mol}$ of $\text{CO(g)}$ and $0.800\text{mol}$ of $\text{H}_2\text{(g)}$ and an $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ catalyst. The flask is heated to a temperature of $290^{\circ}\text{C}$ and allowed to reach equilibrium. Equation 1 shows the reaction.

equation 1 $$\text{CO(g)} + 2\text{H}_2\text{(g)} \rightleftharpoons \text{CH}_3\text{OH(g)}$$

The equilibrium constant, $K_{\text{c}}$, of equation 1 is given.

$$K_{\text{c}} = \frac{[\text{CH}_3\text{OH}]}{[\text{CO}][\text{H}_2]^2}$$

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The equilibrium mixture contains $0.280\text{mol}$ of $\text{CH}_3\text{OH(g)}$.

Calculate the value of $K_{\text{c}}$.

Give your answer to **three** significant figures.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: State and explain the effect, if any, on the value of $K_{\text{c}}$ when the overall pressure in the sealed flask is increased.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem:
$\text{P}_4\text{O}_{10}$ catalyses the reversible reaction of $\text{CO}$ with $\text{H}_2$ to form $\text{CH}_3\text{OH}$.

equation 1 $$\text{CO(g)} + 2\text{H}_2\text{(g)} \rightleftharpoons \text{CH}_3\text{OH(g)}$$

$\text{P}_4\text{O}_{10}$ then acts as a dehydrating agent, causing $\text{CH}_3\text{OH}$ to form $\text{CH}_3\text{OCH}_3$.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Explain how the presence of a catalyst affects a chemical reaction.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Construct an equation for the dehydration reaction of $\text{CH}_3\text{OH}$ to form $\text{CH}_3\text{OCH}_3$.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Write an equation to show the reaction of $\text{P}_4\text{O}_{10}$ with an excess of water.
